# AKNA Capital

> AKNA Capital is a SEBI Registered Research Analyst (INH000023515) based in Mumbai, India. We make financial planning and equity investing easy, helping individuals, families, and businesses grow wealth using fundamental, technical, and quantitative models, data analytics, and AI.

## About AKNA Capital

AKNA Capital runs an in-house Quant Engine built on 30+ smart algorithms to help identify market opportunities and arrive at stock recommendations. We hold a 4.6 rating based on 1,000+ client reviews.

- **Regulatory status:** SEBI Registered Research Analyst, registration INH000023515

## Team

Full profiles at https://aknacapital.com/about#team

- **Smit Ruparel** — Head of Fundamental Research. MBA in Finance (Mumbai University), 10+ years of fundamental research experience, previously at Crisil and Axis Securities, SEBI and NISM registered Research Analyst.
- **Akshat Nahata** — Quant & Technical Research. IIT Indore alumnus, 5+ years of technical and quant experience, previously at Walmart and Axis Securities, AMFI Registered Advisor and NISM Registered Research Analyst.
- **CA Prajvi Nahata** — Equity Research & Multibagger Hunting. Member of ICAI, 8+ years finding multibaggers, previously at Ernst & Young, focused on value investing.
- **Mukul Jain** — Advisory Network, M&A & IPO. MBA from IIM Ahmedabad, Gold Medalist from IIT Indore, CFA Level 1, background in investment banking covering IPO and M&A origination; advises AKNA Capital's M&A and IPO Advisory practice on an independent basis.
- **Harsh Jain** — Business Strategy & Operations. IIT Indore alumnus, ex-Strategy & Operations Lead at VigyanPath, focused on planning and executing growth initiatives and taking products from idea to market.

## Services

Full listing, grouped for individuals vs. business owners, at https://aknacapital.com/services

1. **Research and Ranking**: Ranked equity research suitable for an investment surplus of 3 Lacs to 1 Crore, over a 5-6 year horizon. https://aknacapital.com/services/research-ranking

2. **Mutual Fund Investing**: Algorithm assisted enhanced SIP investing, mapped to specific goals. https://aknacapital.com/services/mutual-fund-investing

3. **AKNA Private Wealth**: Dedicated wealth management for an investment surplus of 1 Crore and above, over an 8-10 year horizon. https://aknacapital.com/services/akna-private-wealth

4. **Stockmarket Workshop**: Educational workshops on fundamental, technical, and quantitative investing, taught by AKNA Capital's own research team. https://aknacapital.com/services/stockmarket-workshop

5. **Insurance**: Guidance on the right health and term life insurance cover. https://aknacapital.com/services/insurance

6. **Algo-Trading**: Converting a trader's own rules and logic into a backtested, automated trading strategy, built on AKNA Capital's Quant Engine. https://aknacapital.com/services/algo-trading

### M&A Advisory and IPO Advisory

Corporate advisory services for promoters, business owners, and CFOs, distinct from the retail wealth advisory above.

7. **Pre-IPO Advisory**: IPO readiness assessment, governance and cap table clean-up, and route selection, 12-24 months before a potential listing. https://aknacapital.com/services/pre-ipo-advisory

8. **IPO and SME IPO Advisory**: Issuer-side advisory for Main-Board IPOs (BSE/NSE) and SME IPOs (BSE SME/NSE Emerge), from merchant banker selection through DRHP, regulatory response, and listing. AKNA Capital is not a SEBI registered merchant banker and does not replace one. https://aknacapital.com/services/ipo-and-sme-ipo-advisory

9. **Buy-side M&A Advisory**: Target identification, valuation, due diligence coordination, and negotiation support for acquirers. https://aknacapital.com/services/buy-side-ma-advisory

10. **Sell-side M&A Advisory**: Sale readiness, valuation benchmarking, confidential buyer outreach, and process management for promoters selling a business. https://aknacapital.com/services/sell-side-ma-advisory
